title: Lime mackerel salad
summary: Lime mackerel salad is a thai dinner built around mackerel fillets and little gem lettuce, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook mackerel fillets for Lime mackerel salad in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm cucumber alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss little gem lettuce with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.
Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Lime mackerel salad straight away. Taste Lime mackerel salad before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

image.alt: Lime mackerel salad served for dinner
